items.title: 3 Consumer Staples Stocks Investors Are Watching As Producer Inflation Heats Up
items.summary: Producer prices are heating up again, and that raises a blunt question for your portfolio. If costs keep climbing faster than consumer inflation and the Federal Reserve stays tough on policy, some businesses may see their profits squeezed while others hold the line. This article explains what the latest PPI surprise could mean for investors and highlights three large-cap consumer staples stocks exposed to this inflation story.
